topic: Hypermobility spectrum disorders and hEDS: Beighton score, management, POTS association

source.title: AGA Clinical Practice Update on GI Manifestations and Autonomic or Immune Dysfunction in Hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome
source.whyItFits: Stored AGA expert review that links hEDS and hypermobility spectrum disorders with POTS, tells gastroenterologists to use the Beighton score as a screen and then the 2017 hEDS criteria, and gives a postural vital-sign definition of POTS. It is a GI-facing document, not the full 2017 classification checklist.

notes: URL in the stored file is the journal page; the advice text is what was read.
